home.hero: A silly content-sharing Discord bot that grows your community!

about.title: About Server Eggs
about.desc:
Server Eggs lets your server create and share content, which is called "Eggs", containing text, media, or both.
These Eggs are then obtainable anywhere the bot is present, and, if they were created in a public server, users who see the Egg can join it, which helps to grow your community!

fun.title: Fun to use!
fun.desc:
Everyone who uses Server Eggs falls in love with it!
Its beautiful, yet simple concept is what your server's members have always wished for!

customizable.title: Customizable!
customizable.desc:
Server Eggs offers plenty of configuration options for Server Managers and users alike!
Language settings, privacy settings, and more!

friendly.title: User-friendly!
friendly.desc:
From the moment your community comes in contact with Server Eggs, they'll know how to use it.
With an extensively detailed /help command, and simple basic /create and /get commands, you couldn't possibly mess up!

mod.title: Moderation-ready!
mod.desc:
With user-generated content come great risks and responsibilities, and we know how to handle them.
Server Eggs provides users and Server Managers with plenty of tools to ensure content safety.
A global report system, per-server and channel filtering and content ratings are just some of the effort we put into making sure everyone has a good experience.

extras.title: Extra-fun features!
extras.desc:
Collect Eggs and pit them against your friends' in a battle whose outcome is decided by the community's votes.
Climb the leaderboards for Egg collections, creations, and battle wins! The fun never ends!

premium.title: Supporter-only perks!
premium.desc: If you decide to support Server Eggs's open source mission for just 2 USD/mo (the minimum price that Discord allows), you can have some extra perks, such as receiving a new Egg to your collection every day, higher chances to find secret Eggs, and nicer rate-limits!
